title: Church Site at Weston GO/UPX Revised With 48- and 54-Storey Rental Towers
summary: Castlepoint Numa has resubmitted plans to the City of Toronto for their Weston Park development, replacing its approved 46- and 50-storey design with 48 and 54 storey towers. Despite six added storeys, the new plans have a lower unit count, while the project shifts from condominium to rental tenure with 20% of the homes intended as affordable units. The redesign also introduces a revised conservation strategy involving partial retention and relocation of Weston Park Baptist Church. Studio JCI replaces
